```{r}
source("_setup.R")
log <- read_fig_csv("cleaning_log.csv")

```

{{< include _sample_warning.qmd >}}

## What this is

[Motus](https://motus.org) is a network of radio receivers that listen for tiny
transmitters carried by migratory animals. An ENGS 89/190 capstone team is installing
a receiver at the Dartmouth Organic Farm, with three directional antennas and one omni
on 166 MHz plus the 434 MHz CTT band. Every detection goes to motus.org, where it is
matched to a registered tag and shared with the researchers who tagged the animal.

This site shows what the data side of the station produces: cleaned detections,
visits and movements, and the station's own health.

## At a glance

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(sprintf(
  "- **%s** detections kept after cleaning, from **%s** raw hits\n- **%d** tags, **%d** of them seen at more than one station\n- **%d** receiver sites within 150 km of the farm, **%d** currently active\n",
  format(tail(log$remaining, 1), big.mark = ","), format(log$remaining[1], big.mark = ","),
  nrow(tags), sum(tags$n_stations > 1), nrow(sites), sum(sites$active == "TRUE" | sites$active == TRUE)))
```
